title: Debug a request, step by step

questions.prompt: curl https://example.com: put the steps in the order they happen.
items: DNS: turn the name into an address
TLS: check who is on the other side
HTTP: send the request, read the status
questions.explanation: Each step has its own tool: dig, nc -vz, openssl s_client, curl -v.

questions.prompt: Put the tools in the order you would use them to debug the request.
